high_level_description: This image captures a serene riverside scene with a calm body of water reflecting the surrounding environment. The river is flanked by lush green vegetation on both sides, creating a natural border that enhances the tranquility of the setting. On the left side of the river, there is a row of buildings painted in shades of pink and red, featuring a cross symbol on one of the structures, suggesting it might be a hospital or a similar institution. The buildings have multiple windows and appear to be residential or institutional.
